register_convention: RH56 position register: 1000 = open stop, 0 = closed stop, linear in rod length

usage: per channel, np.interp(register, register[::-1], joint_rad[j][::-1]) gives joint j; register falls from 1000 to 0 along the arrays. Rod speed v [mm/s] = 1000 * v / stroke_mm register/s
